description: Restyle the whole presentation layer to the classical design from design_reference/new_ui (spec only, never import it): CheckToggle, Hairline, BottomAction, toast, MiniStreakBar, new habit row, Today header, Detail, Add, week strip, points picker, state views, delete dialog, bootstrap loader/error. Depends on FEAT-001 (item.streak) and FEAT-002 (tokens, theme, fonts). Keeps go_router/flutter_bloc/get_it, all pages/routes/blocs/behaviours. Plan sections 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 are the spec. Includes rewriting test/design_rules_test.dart and updating/adding all widget and page tests.
steps: Read plan.md sections 5 to 9 and the prototype files design_reference/new_ui/presentation/widgets/common.dart, pages/today_page.dart, pages/habit_detail_page.dart, pages/add_habit_page.dart plus every file you are about to replace, and the current tests for them.

Add lib/features/habits/presentation/widgets/{check_toggle,hairline,bottom_action,toast,streak_bar}.dart as specified in plan.md section 5/6. CheckToggle: 48x48 hit area around a 34dp circle, outline token `outline`, done = accent border + accentTint fill + Icons.check in accentInk, 200 ms via AppMotion.of, Tooltip + Semantics(button, checked, label) like AnimatedCheck. toast.dart: showToast (190 wide, 1.4 s, hides current, centred short text) and showErrorSnackBar; use snackBarAnimationStyle noAnimation when reduceMotion (verify the API exists in Flutter 3.41, else document the limitation). Delete animated_check.dart and new_habit_button.dart; migrate animated_check_test.dart to check_toggle_test.dart keeping every behaviour assertion.

Add `formatKicker(DateKey)` ('SATURDAY \u00B7 17 OCTOBER') to presentation/utils/date_formatters.dart (full month names, upper case, no intl); remove helpers that become unused (grep first) and add test/features/habits/presentation/utils/date_formatters_test.dart.

Rewrite widgets: habit_tile.dart (prototype row + MiniStreakBar fed by item.streak + points numeral over 'PTS'; keep Dismissible(endToStart) with confirmDismiss that returns false after confirmDeleteHabit, Key('dismiss-<id>'), and the custom semantics action 'Delete habit'); progress_header.dart (kicker, 'Today' 46, numeral 64 + '/ N points', 'X of Y done', 3dp track with animated gold fill 400 ms, Key('progress-bar'), summary Semantics label kept); day_chip.dart + streak_row.dart (38x52 cell, radius 20, gold done state, today double ring Key('today-ring'), same semantics labels); points_picker.dart (Material add/remove 48dp buttons, 4dp outlined field, prototype segmented quick picks, same keys/tooltips/validation, HabitRules 1..1000); state_views.dart (flat track-coloured skeletons keeping keys today-skeleton/detail-skeleton and 'Loading' live region; ErrorView with serif title + danger icon + outlined retry; EmptyView(message) italic serif); confirm_delete_dialog.dart (hairline 4dp dialog, serif title 'Delete habit?', Cancel text button + danger outlined Delete, no animation when reduced motion); app_top_bar.dart Material icons.

Rewrite pages: today_page.dart (Column: ProgressHeader, Hairline, Expanded list with Hairline separators / EmptyView 'No habits yet. Begin with one.' / LoadingView / ErrorView, then BottomAction with OutlinedButton.icon(Icons.add, 'New habit') pushing AppRoutes.addHabit; no FAB; keep ResumeObserver, BlocConsumer listenWhen, FadeSlideIn, row keys); toggling shows the toast from the PRE-toggle state ('+N points' / '-N points') then dispatches TodayEvent.habitToggled; the actionFailure listener calls hideCurrentSnackBar() then showErrorSnackBar. habit_detail_page.dart (kicker 'HABIT', headline name, description, gold-outlined '<N> points' badge + italic 'per completion', Hairline, 'LAST 7 DAYS' + streak numeral + 'day(s)', StreakRow, Hairline, 'X of 7 days' / 'Y points this week', BottomAction OutlinedButton 'Mark today done' / 'Mark today not done' with toast from pre-toggle state, NotFound handling and 'Current streak: N day(s)' semantics kept). add_habit_page.dart (kicker 'ADD' + 'New habit', Hairline, muted kicker field labels, 4dp outlined fields with unchanged keys/validators/HabitRules, PointsPicker, helper text, BottomAction 'Save habit' with gold spinner + 'Saving' semantics, success pops then showToast 'Habit added', failure showErrorSnackBar).

Restyle lib/app.dart bootstrap loader (paper ground, small gold 2dp spinner, serif italic copy, 'Loading' live region) and error screen (ErrorView, real BootstrapException message, outlined 'Retry'). Keep lib/core/router/app_transitions.dart subtle and reduced-motion aware; adjust only if tokens changed.

Rewrite test/design_rules_test.dart per plan.md section 9 (no hex outside app_tokens.dart, no Colors.* except transparent, no em/en dashes, no dark theme/Brightness.dark, no Filled/ElevatedButton, no phosphor/google_fonts/riverpod/intl imports, fonts declared in pubspec with existing TTF/licence files and TTF magic bytes, no Geist, token family constants match pubspec, plus checker self-tests).

Update/add tests: today_page_test (kicker + 'Today', 'N / total points' text pieces, 'X of Y done', mini streak bar segments and 'N-day streak'/'No streak', 'PTS', empty italic copy, bottom 'New habit' button navigates, toast '+N points' and '-N points' from pre-toggle state, toast replaced by error snackbar when the toggle fails, swipe + 'Delete habit' action + confirm flow, no FAB), habit_detail_page_test, add_habit_page_test (validation unchanged, picker, 'Save habit', saving state), points_picker_test, progress_header_test, check_toggle_test, streak_row_test (semantics labels instead of X icons), state_views_test, reduced_motion_test (CheckToggle, progress fill, toast, dialog), accessibility_test and accessibility_themed_test (48dp targets via getSize, no overflow at 320dp wide and 2.0x text for Today with long names, header, empty/loading/error, Detail with long name+description, Add with errors, delete dialog), app_test (bootstrap loader/error text, Today shown). Also add a widget test that a screen reader custom action 'Delete habit' exists on rows.

Create /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/.agents/tasks/test-changes.md (append to the file FEAT-002 started) listing EVERY removed or replaced test case with the reason, plus the final before/after test counts (baseline 356).

Grep checks as sanity only (plan.md section 11): no phosphor/Geist/dark/Filled leftovers, every widget file is referenced, every AppTokens member is used somewhere in lib/, README mentions of Geist/dark/vermilion/phosphor fixed.
Run `dart format .`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test test/architecture_test.dart`, `flutter test` and fix everything.
acceptance_criteria: Today, Detail, Add, delete dialog, bootstrap loader/error and Loading/Error/Empty views visibly follow the classical design (hairlines, outlined 4dp buttons, serif headings, kicker labels, gold strokes, no cards/gradients/filled buttons/FAB) per plan.md section 7.
Each Today row shows CheckToggle, name (w600, dimmed + strikethrough when done), 7 mini segments (gold = done) with 'N-day streak' / 'No streak', and the right-aligned points numeral over 'PTS'.

Tapping a check shows a ~190dp wide dark pill for 1.4 s with '+N points' (item was open) or '-N points' (item was done); when the bloc reports an action failure the toast is hidden and replaced by the error snackbar.

All existing behaviours survive: swipe-to-delete with confirmation and 'Delete habit' custom action, add-habit validation (name required, description <= 200, points 1..1000), 'Mark today done / not done', week cell labels ('Today, done', 'Friday, missed'), 'Current streak: N day(s)', resume-after-midnight, not-found handling, error/retry and bootstrap error with the real message.
Interactive targets are >= 48dp; reduced motion makes animations zero-length and routes appear without transition; no overflow at 2.0x text on a 320dp-wide screen (tested).
design_reference/ is untouched; presentation imports no data/ or Firebase; no intl, google_fonts, riverpod or phosphor in the project; no unused widgets or tokens remain.
test-changes.md lists every removed test with its reason; flutter test is green with a count >= 356 minus the listed dark-only removals; flutter analyze clean; format clean.
findings: Done. flutter test: 391 passing (baseline 356, 364 after FEAT-001, 326 after FEAT-002), flutter analyze clean, dart format clean, test/architecture_test.dart and test/design_rules_test.dart green. test-changes.md lists every replaced/removed assertion with reasons. NEW widgets: check_toggle (48dp target, 34dp circle, outline/gold, AnimatedScale kept so the old scale assertion survives), hairline, bottom_action, toast (showToast 190dp 1.4s, showErrorSnackBar radius 4; snackBarAnimationStyle exists in Flutter 3.41 and is set to AnimationStyle.noAnimation when reduceMotion), streak_bar (MiniStreakBar, keys streak-segment-0..6, one 'N-day streak'/'No streak' semantics label inside the widget). DELETED animated_check.dart, new_habit_button.dart. DECISIONS: (1) Today and Detail put BottomAction in Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar (not in the body Column) so floating toasts sit ABOVE the button instead of covering it; Add keeps it in the body Column so the keyboard shrinks the form and the button stays reachable. (2) Today uses a CustomScrollView (header, hairline, rows/empty fill) so the header scrolls and nothing overflows at 2.0x on 320dp; Add's header scrolls with the form for the same reason. (3) Detail streak unit text is always 'day streak' (prototype); the singular/plural stays in the 'Current streak: N day(s)' semantics label. Streak numeral uses ink, not accent (accent never for text). (4) ErrorView gained an optional kicker (default 'SOMETHING WENT WRONG', bootstrap passes 'OFFLINE'); EmptyView now takes only message. (5) Bootstrap loader is a private _BootstrapLoader in app.dart (kicker, 24dp gold 2dp spinner, italic 'Opening your habits.', 'Loading' live region); bootstrap error uses ErrorView with the real BootstrapException message and 'Retry'. (6) Name and description fields have no labelText: muted kicker labels 'NAME', 'DESCRIPTION', 'POINTS PER COMPLETION' sit above them (tests use keys name-field, description-field, points-field). The picker keeps its 'Points' label and a '1 to 1000 points' hint. (7) Week strip cell: 38x52 (shrinks to the slot width on narrow screens), radius 20, done = accent border + accentTint + check; today ring is a paper-gap + accent BoxShadow pair painted outside the cell (key today-ring, on the cell); missed = 1dp outline border, no X icon. (8) Quick picks are a segmented row (outline border, 4dp) with FittedBox numerals so 5 cells fit 268dp at 2x. (9) Removed unused tokens AppSpacing.s2 and s64, and the unused date formatters formatLongDate, weekdayShort, formatMonthDay; weekdayName and weekdayInitial remain (day chip). AppMotion.spring stays in the untouched app_motion.dart but is now unused. (10) The success toast 'Habit added' is shown right after context.pop(); in widget tests the snackbar hero-flies between scaffolds so two Text widgets can exist for a moment (tests use findsWidgets). design_rules_test now also verifies pubspec fonts, TTF magic bytes, OFL files and token family constants. README got a short Design section. ENV: used a wrapper /tmp/fl.sh (same env as FEAT-001 findings) for flutter analyze/test and /tmp/fmt.sh for dart format; not committed, design_reference/ untouched, data layer, repositories, blocs' events/states, auth/error/time/usecase and DI untouched. Not verified: on-device rendering and real fonts (tests use the Ahem font); FEAT-004 covers the device.
